response.rationale: Both language answers are valid for the stated sense. Indonesian official immigration sources use “visa wisata,” while Malaysian government sources use “visa pelancong.” The terms differ lexically but are semantically equivalent here. No false-friend contrast is present; “pelancong” means tourist, whereas “pelancongan” means tourism.
